audio_source_to_mix.method: Pearson on aligned mono PCM; mix = fitted scalar * committed stem + residual. Residual includes music, effects, AAC error and any nonlinear gain. Not a perceptual or source-separation measurement.

caption_timing.method: Measured Edge word starts drive ASS instant karaoke per word, not proportional allocation by word length. Each nonfinal tag lasts to the next measured word start, rounded to centiseconds; the final tag extends to cue end. The first eligible 30 fps frame is calculated from the ASS time, not measured by observing pixel changes. This validates service telemetry, not human phonetic alignment.
